text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yayyyyy! Hey, hey, guess what!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'm going to be in a wedding!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! A Tracen graduate is planning to
get
married here! I'm going to help her
organize
everything!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And that's not all!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Graduate
text_block_list.text:
This academy is where it all started for
me, so I
want this to be where I begin
this new stage of my
life too!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Graduate
text_block_list.text:
And you, my little muse, are always
doing your
very best to make things
exciting, and when I
looked at you, I had
a thought.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Graduate
text_block_list.text:
If you helped me, my wedding would
definitely be
wonderful and one to
remember!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Isn't that amazing?! She made me her planner! I've gotta do my absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The thing is, I don't really know what a
wonderful
wedding is supposed to be
like.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm gonna go and ask
everyone for
advice! I'm gonna do the
best job I can!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: A wonderful wedding should definitely be really romantic! The couple should hug each other while skydiving! ♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Okay, so them whooshing through the
sky is what
would make the ceremony
wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
They should exchange vows at an
oceanside
church. But then, someone
should stand up,
object to the wedding,
and confess their true
love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I've got a few romance manga with
scenes like
that, if you'd like to borrow
them?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The couple should arrive in a carriage to
make
themselves known, accompanied
by an orchestral
performance. A
traditional wedding like that
would be
wonderful. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A dramatic finale would be stupendous
as well!
They could imbue the power of
love into their
special attacks and shoot
them into the sky—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so Haru Urara continues running
around the
academy in an effort to
gather ideas for a
wonderful wedding...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You're that trainer from before! Hey,
I have
an idea for the wedding!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
First, all the couple's friends fall out of
the sky
together!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And then they all land in the sea! And
then
everyone will greet each other
while listening to
classical music!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And then, when it's time to exchange
vows...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Someone dramatically objects to the
marriage
and confesses their true love!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And that's when they fire their love-powered special attacks...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And go into space!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Do you think the bride will like it?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hmmm. Really? Actually, I kinda figured.
choice_data_list_en: I f-feel like everything about this is wrong...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I got all kinds of advice and suggestions,
but
planning a wonderful wedding sure
is tough.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I just haven't asked enough
people yet! I'll
try seeing what everyone
else says! The bride
trusted me with this,
so I've gotta do everything I
can!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Ikuno and Curren! So I'm helping
plan a
wedding, and...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I have to do my best, but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I rush to Haru Urara's side after she
takes a
tumble. However...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hmm... The wedding... The wedding...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She gets up on her own, then wanders
off,
mumbling to herself as she goes...
